# KI: In-Flight Plain-Text Tool-Call Stream Normalization & Repair

## Operational Summary
LLMs frequently emit tool calls as plain-text JSON codeblocks (e.g. ```json { "tool": ... } ``` or raw function call syntax) instead of native provider tool call events, particularly during streaming or when models experience slight instruction drift. Intercepting these plain-text blocks in-flight and promoting them into validated structured tool events eliminates downstream agent failure loops without requiring expensive LLM re-prompting.
